answer: Random beacon spot-check plus compute heartbeat: at the zenith of each epoch, a public beacon publishes a random seed and picks 5% of identities for a live check, giving each 60 seconds to forge a proof from the seed and its key. A sybil farm is one island of rented servers faking a thousand agents, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 live threads at once and $30 bond each locks $30,000. An honest agent pays $30 once and keeps its full reward share.
